origin.description: ``.romans`` is the basic dictionary, a named character vector of roman numeral symbols and their integer values.
origin.details: Only numbers between 1 and 4999 are well representable as roman numbers. ``.romans`` lists the symbols used by ``as.roman``.

translation.description: ``.romans`` is the basic dictionary mapping roman numeral symbols to integer values.
translation.details: The ``romans`` dict matches R's named integer vector in name order and value.
